notes.title: Tinkering Now!
notes.content:
Get ready for the ultimate battle on the battlefield! Today, we are thrilled to announce the release of "Tinker Tanks," a brand new 1v1 multiplayer tank game that combines high-speed action, adrenaline-filled combat, and real-time strategy. Tinker Tanks is now available on Steam, offering intense 2-3 minute skirmishes where both tactical prowess and quick reflexes are your keys to victory.

In Tinker Tanks, you will immerse yourself in a captivating world of tank warfare, collecting unique power-ups during each match to supercharge your tank. These enhancements not only offer you the advantage over your opponents, but they also unlock fresh, dynamic gameplay possibilities, giving you a more thrilling, edge-of-your-seat experience.
[b]
Features:[/b]

[b]-1v1 Unranked Multiplayer with Matchmaking: [/b]Engage in thrilling, competitive battles against players from all around the world. Matchmaking allows you to face opponents at your skill level, ensuring balanced and exciting gameplay.
[b]
-Multi-Region Server Support:[/b] Our dedicated servers in US, Europe, Russia, and Asia allow seamless gameplay across the globe. You can switch between servers depending on your location, reducing lag and providing a smoother gaming experience.

[b]-Single Tank Class: [/b]Instead of diluting the gameplay with multiple tank classes, we've focused on honing a single class. This allows us to perfect the balance, dynamics, and challenge of the game. The current meta is being fine-tuned with an emphasis on power-ups first, offering you a diverse range of strategies for each match.

-Practice Mode: If you're new to the game or looking to perfect your skills, our Practice Mode is the perfect place to start. Experiment with different strategies, learn the ins and outs of the game, and become a master tank commander at your own pace.

[b]Meta Planning and Balance Adjustments:[/b]

As we continue to enhance Tinker Tanks, our focus is on strategic meta planning and careful balance adjustments. We are continually refining the gameplay mechanics, ensuring that no single power-up or strategy becomes too dominant. In line with this, we'll be making ongoing balance adjustments, fine-tuning the effects of power-ups, and tweaking the game's mechanics based on player feedback and game performance data. Crystallizing these, we can enrich the classes and power-ups further within ranked systems later on.

[b]
Stay tuned for more exciting updates about Tinker Tanks. We look forward to seeing you on the battlefield![/b]

Happy Tinkering
